newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Centamin says has high grade gold in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Centamin says has high grade gold in Egypt.

text.p: Minerals explorer Centamin NL said on Tuesday it had uncovered wide samples of high grade gold in Egypt's eastern desert at the Sukhari concession area.

Among intercepts recorded were 37 metres at 12 grammes per tonne gold (g/t), 39 metres at 11 g/t, 48 metres at 7.3 g/t and 75 metres at 9.0 g/t. Further drilling to prove up a preliminary resource by the end of June was planned with the ability to earn up to an 80 percent interest in the area, Centamin said.
Centamin shares ended up 0.002 cents at 6.4 cents on turnover of 3.02 million shares.
